# R6.12 — REPLAY + ARCHIVE (a) (manifest 265)

**Merge policy: OPERATOR — do not merge.**

## Semantics landed

**REPLAY (§4.9; REQ-XC-122 absorbs REQ-XD-108; design/33 F15; design/36 §1.3/P1–P9).** `ProxyMode{live|record|replay}`. `record` captures each slot's calls into `hh.model_proxy.recording/1` — per call `k`: downstream request bytes (capture point 1), upstream-bound body after lane transforms (capture point 2 — the match key), verbatim upstream `{status, headers, body, chunk_stamps}`, released downstream bytes, §4.3 disposition, recorded latency. `provenance ∈ recorded | synthetic` (P6); the codec is closed. `seal_recording{slot_id}` deposits the manifest (leak-scanned) and lands `model.proxy.recording.sealed` (new class-table row — the proxy is sole writer).

`replay` binds `ReplayConfig{recordings, canonicalizer, strict, keying ∈ sequence|sequence_then_hash, latency ∈ immediate|recorded}` at configure — **no upstream port** (catalog probe skipped, nothing dialed) and **no budget charge by construction** (no root pool, no slice, no reservation — zero `control.budget.*`/`measurement.cost.attributed` rows). Receipts carry `proxy.mode` and `proxy.replay{k, verdict, first_diff_path?, canonicalizer, keying, strict, dropped_paths?}`.

**`RequestCanonicalizer`** (`hh-gateway::replay`): `identity` (byte equality), `json_canonical` (`parse_provider` → `Json::to_canonical_string` — CC1), `hh-l1-canon` (the existing `L1Canon`; `first_diff` exposed as `first_diff_path`, no second comparator). `match_requests` → `exact | canonical_equal | diverged{first_diff_path}`. Strict → typed 409 `replay_diverged` and the slot ends; lenient serves and records — never gate evidence. `sequence` serves the smallest unserved index; `sequence_then_hash` scans outstanding calls by canonical hash (F15's interleaved repair). A slot-bound locally-refused request consumes one index (`verdict: refused_local`) so record-mode trajectories align. Sequence end → typed 409 `replay_exhausted` (P5). Streaming requests serve the recorded SSE head + body re-chunked by recorded `chunk_stamps` (P7); `latency: recorded` sleeps the recorded latency (P9).

**`RecordedTransport`** — a `Transport` serving the same recording rows to native runs through the extracted `decode_exchange_frames` (`HttpModelTransport::raw_frames`' own decoding path — no second decoder): emitted `WireFrame`s equal the live decode of the same bytes. `send` past the sequence is a typed `replay_exhausted` refusal; `with_matcher` records verdicts and refuses `replay_diverged` when strict.

**ARCHIVE (a) (§4.10; REQ-XF-124, REQ-XH-101; ADR-0430/AR-20).** `hh-receipt-index/1` in `hh-runner::receipt_index` — the committed record (never a store): `dataset{repo, revision, visibility}`, per-attempt `files[]` over closed roles `{raw_receipts, transcript, atif, egress_log, native_log, store_segment}`, pass `artifacts[]` over `{layer_export, bundle, binary_set}` with `upload ∈ archived | digest_only` (no uploaded path), `scans{}`, `supersedes[]`, `tombstone{reason}` — closed codec, malformed refuses. `packet_fold` recomputes `{consumed_micros, calls, receipts, dispositions}` from durable events. `hh-runner::condenser` writes deterministic `transcript.jsonl` (trial header, positional message dedup, one `call` line per receipt) through the `hharness-secrets` `redact` hook — the R6.23 tombstone point. `git ls-files` holds no archive bytes.

**Offline enforcement (REQ-XC-125).** `scripts/check-proxy-offline.sh` fails on any proxy test naming a non-loopback endpoint literal without `#[ignore]` + ADR-0363 — a seeded live test was verified to trip it. CI step added (`mode != 'fast'`).
